decisions.reason: Despite its missing standalone web presence after 2019, the adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet remains a core, customizable display format that fits the firm's established capabilities and service model.
The pegboard-back cardboard display still strengthens the firm's standard POS range for retailers, even if later website visibility suggests some consolidation of presentation.
This standard cardboard quarter-pallet appears most exposed to portfolio rationalization because it overlaps strongly with other core quarter-pallet variants and was no longer visibly promoted.
The eighth-pallet format serves a distinct retail footprint and therefore remains useful in a focused display portfolio despite weaker later visibility on the website.

The media-oriented quarter-pallet is the most niche of the remaining cardboard formats, and with no later observed promotion its resources are better redirected to broader core business and new development.
